Article: Moscow (CNN)The primary suspect jailed in connection with the shooting death of Boris Nemtsov withdrew his confession Wednesday, saying he had been under duress during his admission and isn't guilty. Summary: Zaur Dadayev says he was tortured while he was in custody and, because he was scared, he confessed .
